 * City News Alerts *
 Posted on November 17, 2026 
 FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE November 17, 2026
 City Tax Deadline 
 CHARLOTTESVILLE, VA –  The Treasurer’s Office would like to notify taxpayers that City of Charlottesville second half 2026 real estate and personal property taxes are due Monday, December 7. Payments can be made in-person, by mail, by phone, or online at https://www.charlottesville.gov/568/Personal-Property-Taxes and https://www.charlottesville.gov/571/Real-Estate-Taxes .
 If you have not received your bill, please contact the Treasurer’s Office prior to the due date at 434-970-3146 or citytreas@charlottesville.gov .
 Media Contact Afton Schneider Director of Communications and Public Engagement City of Charlottesville 434-996-0331 media@charlottesville.gov
